item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Busy day, lots of moving pieces — interviews, dog stuff, pickups — and eating slides fast on days like that. Good sign already: you're drinking plenty of water. Don't let that substitute for actual meals though. Between dinner at five and the rest of the evening routine, make sure something real and solid gets eaten, not just grazed. Action: eat one proper sit-down meal today, no screen, no multitasking.
